The projection of the intersection between the hyperbolic cylinder 3(x+1)2−6(z−2)2=12 and the plane y=1 onto the xz-plane is a hyperbola. What are the lengths of the semi-axes of the hyperbola?

a
2 and 2
b
2 and 1
c
22 and 2
d
4 and 2
e
4 and 1
